name: minihrm-root
description: Mini HRM - Hệ thống Quản trị Tổ chức & Nhân sự Doanh nghiệp (Go + DynamoDB + Next.js)

scripts.docker:up: wsl -d Ubuntu bash -c "cd /mnt/d/vscode/miniHRM && docker compose up -d"
scripts.docker:down: wsl -d Ubuntu bash -c "cd /mnt/d/vscode/miniHRM && docker compose down"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "DOCKER,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,blue,magenta" "npm run docker:up" "npm run backend:dev" "npm run frontend:dev"
